verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine runs structured actions automatically or manually, driven by incident trigger events and run conditions, across 152 action types. Documented actions include creating Slack/Teams incident channels, updating stakeholders and filing tickets. AI SRE investigation rules automatically investigate alerts, which covers the diagnostics step. missing for 10: an explicit 'runbook' object attached to incidents with ordered steps (evidence shows workflows, not runbooks per se), explicit documentation of task/role assignment actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
